info.name: Chama Management API
info.description:
Every endpoint of the Chama Management API (local dev: {{baseUrl}}).

1. Run the requests in **0. Log in**: they save the platform, official and member tokens.
2. Most requests use the official's token; 'my ...' requests use the member's; Platform uses the admin's.
3. List and create requests save the ids that later requests use ({{loanId}}, {{penaltyId}}, ...).

Every response has the same envelope: { success, message, data, meta?, error?, timestamp }. Amounts are minor units (500000 = KES 5,000); rates are basis points (200 = 2%). Public auth requests name the chama with the X-Chama-Code header. See docs/api/response-format.md for error codes, and /swagger-ui.html for the live schema.

request.description: Every field is optional; null fields are left unchanged.
Amounts are minor units (500000 = KES 5,000). Rates are basis points (200 = 2%).
Saves {{membershipId}} and {{memberUserId}} of {{memberEmail}}, and a {{guarantorUserId}}.
Roles: MEMBER, CHAIRPERSON, TREASURER, SECRETARY, AUDITOR.
Methods CASH, BANK, MPESA; MPESA and BANK need a reference. paidOn defaults to today.
